bugs.name: Organization Labels count uses plural for one label
bugs.summary: The organization Labels page uses plural wording when exactly one label exists.
bugs.actual: After creating one label, the header reads “1 labels.”
reproSteps: Create a disposable organization and open Settings > Labels.

bugs.name: The repository Labels page uses the plural “labels” when the list contains exactly one label.
bugs.summary: The repository Labels page displays 1 labels when exactly one label exists.
bugs.expected: The count should use singular wording for one item, such as “1 label”.
bugs.actual: With one label in the list, the page displays “1 labels”.
reproSteps: In a disposable repository, open Issues > Labels and create exactly one label.
Read the header; it says 1 labels rather than 1 label.

bugs.name: Mobile repository label rows run label names into the issue-count text
bugs.summary: At a 390px-wide viewport, a long repository label name overlaps the adjacent open issue/pull request count.
bugs.expected: The label name and its issue-count text should remain visually separate and readable.
bugs.actual: The label name extends into the adjacent issue-count column, making the two values difficult to distinguish.
reproSteps: Sign in as a repository administrator and open Issues > Labels in a disposable repository.
Set the browser viewport to 390 × 844 CSS pixels.
Create a fresh label with a long name such as qa-meta-mobile-label-20261009-unique.
Inspect its row and observe that the label name overlaps the adjacent open issue/pull request count.

bugs.name: Whitespace-only project, milestone, and label names are accepted
bugs.summary: Required name fields accept spaces and persist visually nameless projects, milestones and labels.
bugs.expected: Reject required names that are blank after trimming and ask for a visible name.
bugs.actual: Submitting spaces as the name creates and persists projects, milestones and labels whose names render blank. Label selectors consequently contain an unnamed option.
reproSteps: Sign in and open /momentic-admin/-/projects; click New project.
Enter three spaces in Title and create the project. Reload the project list.
Open /momentic-admin/field-notes/milestones/new; enter three spaces in Title and create the milestone. Inspect the milestone list.
Open /momentic-admin/field-notes/labels; click New label, enter three spaces in Name, and create the label. Inspect the label list and an issue's Labels selector.

matchingGuidance.acceptanceScope: Only the core failure described in this reference is accepted; the stronger original subclaims remain unestablished.
